corrected_prose.impact: Dimensional notation correction only; saved moment values/calculator/source unchanged.
corrected_prose.prior_issue: Initial source-review text displayed the cube-root radius expression as M3/N rather than (M3/N)^(1/3).

gamma_moments.ratio_scope: Shape-conditional ideal radius-moment factors, not a confidence interval, optical error range or prescription for radiation.

native_formula.conditional_algebra: For volumetric Nc=M0 and L=rho*qc with spherical liquid density rho_water, unbounded r_native=0.5*(L/(pidnc*Nc))^(1/3)=[3L/(4*pi*rho_water*Nc)]^(1/3)=(M3/M0)^(1/3).
native_formula.units_and_occurrence_condition: Nc volumetric convention and common mass/number occurrence are assumptions, not established by the generic #/kg Registry label. Radius gates use nc*rho whereas the slope expression uses nc; returned radius uses grid condensate and no explicit CF argument.

sample_controls.actual_source_precision_caution: Samples are ideal analytic values, not compiled UDM evaluations. Native/collision exponents, pi, recmin/recmax and rgmma tables use default-real arithmetic; rgmma is a finite-product approximation and collision lambda has explicit bounds. No runtime bitwise Gamma or mass/number closure claim follows.
sample_controls.method: Independently rederived volume from mass per number and spherical volume; derived Gamma effective radius with the simplified shape factor. Checked all shape choices and native bounds.

saved_quadrature_controls.method: Saved 64-node Gauss-Laguerre values independently compared to exact integer factorial moments; saved ratio independently recomputed and compared to the simplified analytic expression. No new quadrature integration was executed.

source_continuity.scope: Local source continuity to PR7, not upstream WRF equivalence or proof this source was used in any particular forecast.

stage_identity.conditions: 0<CF<=1, identical volumetric Nc and density, L_grid=CF*L_in, same spherical formula, inactive guards and clipping.
stage_identity.source_basis: qci/qrs are divided by diagnosed cldf then restored; these explicit divide/restore blocks do not scale ncr. Radius calculation follows return using grid-mean condensate.
stage_identity.trajectory_limit: Microphysics also changes condensate and number during the timestep. This algebra does not describe arbitrary pre-step/post-step radius changes and does not establish whether returned Nc is an in-cloud or grid-mean number concentration.

unresolved_scientific_contracts: Whether LB2017 autoconversion Gamma PSD is also the intended radiation PSD is not declared by these source blocks.
Live QNC producer/update units and grid/in-cloud occurrence convention need actual value-scale/source tracing; generic metadata alone neither proves volumetric semantics nor a port defect.
Liquid optics table assumptions and intended radiation radius metric remain independent contracts; no opacity/flux/forecast/observation was evaluated.

Native clipping and placeholders can break the unbounded identity and can reverse an apparent ratio comparison against the clipped radius; do not apply the 1.060..1.277 factor as an automatic production correction.
